verdict.rationale: Penpot is documented (and runtime-confirmed) as a fully self-hostable, open-source design platform deployable via docker compose or Kubernetes/Helm, with data-privacy guarantees and no vendor lock-in [penpot-docs-7,17,26,28,30,penpot-probe-rt-1]. Community reports corroborate successful self-hosting on Docker for real teams, though some users report crashes/performance issues at scale [penpot-comm-9,12] vs [penpot-comm-10,11,15]. Missing for 10: consistent large-scale stability evidence and official benchmarks to fully resolve the mixed self-hosting performance reports.
